title: inheritance (TPH + TPC) × a concrete's `policy { read … }` gate × a concrete's `mask unless` field × the polymorphic base reads
note: The base read checks every concrete's list-read gate before it loads (403 for a caller who fails any) and masks each row through its concrete's own serializer.  The 403 half is the authz ladder (`AUTHZ_LADDERS`, test/behavioral/cases.mjs).

authzGate.//: The masked concretes' reads: the visitor reads them as the agent does, nulls and all.  The gated concretes and every base read are refused by the ladder; the masked writes are its `→ 403` mask-gate rungs.

//: The polymorphic base reads under each concrete's read gate (inheritance-read-gates.ddd): one gated concrete in each hierarchy makes the whole base read 403 for a caller who fails its gate, on the list and the TPH by-id read, and 200 for one who passes.

The base read's ladder (`readLadder`): every concrete's list-read gate runs before the load, so a refused caller gets 403 for a missing id too — the refusal says nothing about which rows exist. The gated concretes' own reads — the 403 the base read mirrors. The masked concretes' write gate (docs/auth.md): neither harness principal is an auditor, so a new masked value is refused for both; the control is the same update without it going through.
